origin: Q procedural costumes, equipment, body geometry and surface microstructure, with registered MakeHuman hm08 CC0 anatomical head. The smith face alone uses the official MakeHuman CC0 skin color image. No scans, image-generation output or mocap provenance is claimed.
license: Q project-authored source under repository terms; MakeHuman head source and derivative are CC0-1.0 (see anatomical-head-provenance.json and sources/MAKEHUMAN-LICENSE-ASSETS.md).
separateUnmodifiedAssets: The adjacent pilgrim.glb, knight.glb, keeper.glb and provenance.json preserve Kay Lousberg CC0 attribution. They are not the source of the new procedural bodies.
geometryMethod: Continuous shaped torso, sleeves, trouser legs, boots, digits and canine trunk/tail. Smooth multi-joint weights across joint collars, explicit human spine/digits and canine hocks; UV seams retain averaged normals. Armor/equipment stay rigid. Material batches and immutable geometry shared across instances; bones and deforming cape independent. All material batches within an actor share one skeleton palette; each actor has independent cloned bones.

animationRecipe.origin: Original analytic poses with a continuous saved combat clock, two-hand weapon frames and fixed-length arm IK, and visual-only contact/transition logic. No motion capture imported.

qualityBoundary: Smith face uses an acquired CC0 graphical skin color map; all other roles retain flat skin. Actual lit appearance, face-neck boundary, device FPS and PS4/flagship parity remain unverified. Source contains socket/crease darkness, not calibrated illumination-free albedo.
